simple.meaning: מַשּׁוּאָה (mashshûwʼâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “ruin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַשּׁוּאָה (H4876) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 73:18, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַשּׁוּאָה (H4876) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַשּׁוּאָה (H4876) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַשּׁוּאָה (mashshûwʼâh) / H4876 is traced through Psalms 73:18, Psalms 74:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
